Home Health Aide — Platinum Home Care
July 2023 – April 2025 · Brooklyn, NY
Completed 75 hours of professional training. Assisted patients with Activities of Daily Living including grocery shopping and house cleaning. Reminded patients of medication schedules and upcoming doctor visits.

Intern & Physician Shadowing — North Manhattan Eye Center
June 2023 – August 2023 · New York, NY
Guided patients to examination rooms and gathered background information. Participated in brainstorming sessions on improving the work environment. Interacted with physicians and staff to learn diagnostic processes and eye pathology identification.
